{"metadata":{"description":"Editable, session-isolated personalization memory for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1333513791","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"mindspace-dsh-session-memory","slug":"Spirtxiaoqi7/mindspace-dsh-session-memory","topics":["agent-memory","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","memory","personalization","roleplay","session-memory"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Editable, session-isolated personalization memory for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Mindspace Memory for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 · Community plugin · MIT"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Separate work from everyday conversation. Maintain memory beyond context summaries.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Chat and Work are two memory contexts for the same user and assistant, not two tool-permission prese"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ts. Each stores people, relationships, preferences, assistant identity, current state and lasting ex"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"tores people, relationships, preferences, assistant identity, current state and lasting experiences."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What's new in 0.7"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Independent maintenance after compaction.** The main model can still write memory, but is no lon"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ger solely responsible for remembering. After successful compaction, a separate model call reconcile"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"s existing memory against the original conversation captured before summarization.
- **Updates inste"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ad of blind accumulation.** Maintenance adds durable omissions, corrects superseded facts and merges"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" duplicates. Absence from recent conversation is not a deletion reason.
- **No shortest-card evictio"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"n.** Each card section supports up to 100 entries. Exceeding three entries no longer removes the sho"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"rtest one.
- **Settings inheritance.** Create a blank session with the current Chat/Work memories, p"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"eople, identity, bridge and compaction policy, without copying conversation history.
- **General cur"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"rent state.** Appearance or clothing may be described here, but is not a required dedicated feature."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Interaction"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Use the composer **Chat / Work** chip to express the current context. The model may also switch when"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" the main intent changes. Modes never disable tools or alter permissions."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"In **Settings → Personalization**, inspect/edit memory, inherit it into a new session, change the co"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"mpaction policy or compact manually."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Cross-context facts are staged in a neutral bridge: a short transition note (up to 300 characters) p"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"lus pending write instructions. Only after entering the target mode does the model merge or dismiss "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"instructions. Only after entering the target mode does the model merge or dismiss each pending item."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Maintenance lifecycle"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Compaction captures the original textual conversation since the last successful compaction. On succe"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ss, a separate request receives this evidence and current memory, then proposes source-linked operat"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ions. Long conversations are processed in ordered batches rather than truncated."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Memory revisions are checked before applying changes. Concurrent edits cause a retry against the lat"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"est state; cross-mode changes remain staged. Failed calls preserve memory and task evidence, with up"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" to three attempts per batch. Background maintenance does not block ordinary conversation."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"This incurs additional model usage after compaction, not after every turn. Empty provider/model sett"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ings reuse the session route; a dedicated lower-cost model can be selected. No tools are supplied to"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" the maintenance call. Model judgments can still be corrected in the Memory Center."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Override the installed bundle in your Web profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Restart after configuration changes. Compaction enablement/thresholds are per-session; maintenance c"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"onfiguration is plugin-wide. Successful manual compaction also triggers maintenance."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Compatibility and migration"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Version **0.7.1 verifies the communication interfaces against DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 and desktop 0.2.0-rc.2*"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"*, with a declared range of `>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.3.0`. Keep plugin 0.6.10 on the older 0.1.1 core until "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"upgrading DSH. Plugin 0.7.0 lacks the strict Typert `codec.create()` factories required by DSH 0.2, "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"preventing both Personalization and the mode chip from appearing."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Storage remains under `DSH_HOME/mindspace-session-memory/v1`; the directory name is not the document"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" format version. V5 Chat/Work documents remain unchanged. Existing V1–V4 data is read through the mi"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"gration path into Chat without inventing a Work persona. Legacy memory events can still be imported;"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" new memory writes remain outside canonical session logs."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Maintenance tasks and original evidence live in `DSH_HOME/mindspace-session-memory/maintenance`. The"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"se are local user data, not repository artifacts. Back up DSH_HOME before upgrading. DSH handles its"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" own session-format migration; use the matching pre-upgrade backup when rolling back."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Install from source"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"No DSH core patch is required. Do not load a duplicate legacy implementation alongside this plugin. "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"Manual edits, model writes and maintenance share the same storage and revision path."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"See CHANGELOG. This is not an official DeepSeek project."}],"truncated":false}
